name: Nauseating Barrier, Greater
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, paladin 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3
Duration 1 round/level or until discharged

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as nauseating barrier, except as noted above, and it provides a +2 bonus to AC and on saving throws. It is not discharged until it has nauseated a number of creatures equal to your caster level.
